line: Someone helps without asking today. Accept the lift and skip the rain.
A rainy Saturday clears your head. Make a cup of tea and plan December.
Your helpfulness gets noticed today. Fix the family Wi-Fi and take a bow.
Saturday asks a lot of you. Do the errands in one loop, then rest.
Slow spending suits you today. Fix it, don't replace it.
A small win waits at the shops today. Check the clearance shelf first.
Your stories are good today. Tell the one that makes Grandma laugh.
Cosy fun suits you today. Film marathon, blanket, no guilt.
Someone wants the sofa too. Share it, and share the snacks.
Your favourite people are near today. Invite them over for steamboat.
